Afterward, delete the temporary directory, reset the snapshot, and confirm that antivirus settings, exclusions, services, startup entries, and firewall rules are identical to the baseline. The facilitator can distribute an event timeline and ask participants to identify the earliest useful signal, write a containment step, and propose a recovery check. This creates realistic defensive telemetry and a repeatable detection challenge while leaving the security controls intact and avoiding a transferable virus.
